heuristics.statement: For the claws the u-table procedure finds, Pr[C1 and C2 and G and F7] = q_pf = 57,726,359,870,197 x 287,309,824 / 2^90 = 2^-16.1877, the rate enumerated exhaustively over all 2^32 words (P(C1) = 1/8, |C1 and C2| = 53,096,854, the W9 G count 57,726,359,870,197, |F7| = 287,309,824); the stage rates 1/8, 2^-6.3379, 2^-12.2857 set the mean post-filter cost. With the window (Section 3.7) the G rate is the exact count over SEL, P(G | C1 C2, SEL) = 2,051,404,269,120 / (2^20 x 53,096,854) = 0.0368453386, and F7 stays at |F7|/2^32: q_pf(SEL) = 2^-15.0022. heuristics.extrapolation: Registered P1/base q3 and paired runs, diagnostics and lower bounds remain in Section 9 and historical P/Q. Because Section 7 now runs deterministically over all N_E=2^32 values of ustart (full cycle), the deterministic product bound withdraws Lemma T and the registered upper form a-bar <= 2^10*q3r (1 - 2^-25 is retained solely as a conservative factor).
heuristics.limitations: Participant-run sequential Monte Carlo with a heavy-tailed middle stage; the deep rows (about 2^-71 per good pair) are represented through the declared transfer premises; premises (a) and (b) transfer beyond the measured P1 components (sensitivity of (a): up to about 0.37 bit of time_log2 if the gain were absent); the u-table's retention weighting of u is covered by H7.
heuristics.scope: q3r, hence N_CV and the full attack cost; Section 7 deterministic full-cycle ustart withdraws Lemma T and a-bar (retained 1-2^-25 is purely conservative).
heuristics.statement: A good pair of the u-table procedure is accepted by step 3b with probability q3r >= q3_P1 x 2^32 / 160 = 2^-71.4010, where q3_P1 = 2^-96.0791 = q3_model x 2^D_LB (q3_model = 2^-96.0133, D_LB = -0.0658 on W9 = [9*2^26, 10*2^26)). Every a0 in SEL lies in W9, its claws' a1 are uniform (H1), and its u = W1 is retained from fixed R*=8174 under H7. Inherited transfers: (a) +0.41488 bit relaxation gain transfers from A0-variant to P1; (b) q3 does not depend on n(a1) re-weighting. Under Section 7's deterministic full-cycle ustart product bound, no per-table Lemma T or a-bar upper bound is required or active.

heuristics.extrapolation: The inherited registered estimator, confidence interpretation and limitations remain in Section 9 and historical P/Q/R. No finite current check validates a probability near 2^-96.
heuristics.limitations: Participant-run tool, not executed by the organizer; heavy-tailed middle stage (some ratio seeds die, counted as 0); the estimator is validated on known answers and on its own reproductions, not on an independent implementation.
heuristics.scope: q3_model and D_LB, hence q3r, N_CV and the attack term (the same scope as H2-P1).
heuristics.statement: The sequential Monte Carlo estimator traillab (the lineage's own C tool, not shipped), with which q3_model and the paired difference D_LB were measured, estimates the accepted-event rate of the stated model without material bias. It replays every sample on real 38-step compressions of both members (0 replay mismatches required), treats rows 16..21 as the importance-split prefix (8,192 particles, 256 proposals per row; the row-16 stage is exact with weight 160/2^32) and counts EXACT (zero output difference after step 37) in the window rows 22..37. Its per-seed values, combined by the registered one-sided rules, give conservative bounds for the true rate.

heuristics.extrapolation: Registered 24-CV panel in Section 8 and Appendix V section support-8. Under the deterministic full-cycle ustart theorem (Section 7), linearity of expectation across all 2^32 tables means only the (u, cv)-averaged bound E[X(X-1)] <= 2^-7.5 E[X] is required.
heuristics.limitations: Not testable at the acceptance probability; components only. The 24-CV panel was not stratified by the cv0 class, and the marginal class-rate measurements (F7R, MSG_CLS on an independent pool) do not by themselves establish a factorial-moment inequality, so the class-conditioned transfer is declared, not measured.
heuristics.scope: The Bonferroni factor is the constant 1 - 2^-8.5 = 0.99723786413599... per chaining value: E[J(J-1)]/2 <= 2^-8.5 E[J], and with E[J]=NA*ca_lo*q_pf*q3r=2^-65.24 the absolute loss is 2^-73.74. The factor multiplies E[J] once and carries no E[J] inside the correction. The tighter evaluation recorded in Appendix V section support-8 (2^-61.8) is not charged because it needs a bound on E[K(K-1)]/E[K] that the premise does not supply: K = 2^20 with probability about 2^5.99/2^20 and K = 0 otherwise keeps E[K] and gives E[J(J-1)]/E[J] = q3r(2^20-1), far above 2^-61.8 and still below the declared 2^-7.5. An earlier revision wrote 1 - 2^-8.5*E[J]; that is invalid and withdrawn.
heuristics.statement: Group independence within a chaining value (the form of H5-group-independence of the accepted 44870635): good pairs of one chaining value that share no endpoint (a0 or u) are independent trials of the accepted event, each with probability q3r; good pairs sharing an endpoint form a group counted once. Consequence used: for a uniform chaining value and any table, J (accepted good pairs among all claws of the chaining value) has E[J(J-1)] <= 2^-7.5 E[J]. This filing applies the same premise to the kept-CV class ((cv0 >> 24) & 63 == 12): the class conditions only cv[0], the panel below is drawn from uniform chaining values (so about 1/64 of its CVs are in-class), and the transfer of the second-moment bound to the class-conditioned law is part of this declared premise.

heuristics.statement: (a0) The 152,868 KiB encoder figure of H6-D bounds the live clause objects of the historical P8 encoder process at the end of construction (every clause list of F_hist with its item array, and the int objects outside -5..256 held by its sha256_model clauses), resident and not swapped out or compressed; these are the only objects the record and token bounds read, and R.6D does not use this reading. (a) The encoder ran on a default 64-bit CPython 3: each clause of F_hist was a distinct list of at least 56+8k bytes, each literal sdmodel.apply computed outside the small-int cache -5..256 a distinct int object of at least 26 bytes, and PySAT's CNF kept each clause as that list or a copy holding the same objects. (b) The measured P8RR allowances transfer to the historical platform: recorder overhead 2 MiB, regenerator 32 MiB, decoder 96 MiB, filter 1 MiB, launcher 4 MiB, 1 MiB kernel state per process, 1 MiB for Kissat reading a pipe, 1 MiB per pipe; retained files are rounded to 4 KiB pages. (d) Assumed: the spec was shorter than 2 MiB, as one execve argument of the published sweep allows on Linux with pages of at most 64 KiB or on macOS; it bounds the launcher's, decoder's and output's copies of the spec.

heuristics.extrapolation: The class F7 rate 0.1205926 (upper 0.1206112) and message factor 2^-0.0225 were measured on pools independent of the class selection, with a second pool for F7R and MSG_CLS, so both factors are post-selection-independent measurements; the class is a 2^-6 cv0 condition with three charged operations per first block. The rows 17..21 panels are in Appendix T; the 64-class search, rates, paired evidence and bounds remain in Section 3.8 and Appendix V. Finite controls do not establish rows 16..37 invariance.
heuristics.limitations: Rows 16..37 of the state part are not directly measurable at the claimed probability; H9 covers that gap, supported by the independent-pool class rates, the balanced 64-class search and the shallow-row panels rather than by a measurement of the deep event. The F7 rate is the one-sided 99% bound of the exhaustive-density Rao-Blackwell estimator, 0.1206019 +- 0.0000031 over 3.21e7 X-samples, whose exact control (equal-weight mean over the 256 byte-classes) returns 0.066894531 against 0.06689453125.
heuristics.scope: Inherited historical sensitivity/comparison only: q_pf and q3r in N_CV and the step-3b cost term: the class raises q_pf by 0.1205926 / 0.0668945 = 2^0.8413 and, after the charged message factor and the class test (3 operations per first block), gives time_log2 76.7653 (without the class: 77.5450; 8116a55c: 77.1297).
heuristics.statement: Only first blocks whose chaining value is in the class ((cv0 >> 24) & 63) == 12 are kept (2^-6 of them; proof.md Section 3.8). (a) Under H1 a kept chaining value has cv[0] uniform in the class and its other words uniform; for the claws of a kept chaining value C1, C2 and G pass at the rates of H1-P1 (they do not read the chaining value), and F7 passes at the class average of the F7 rate over the good-pair law of q, charged at F7R = 0.1205926 and the step-3b cost at the upper bound 0.1206112, the two one-sided 99% bounds of the class rate from the exhaustive-density estimator (per-top-byte F7 density enumerated over all 2^32 words, reproducing |F7| = 287,309,824; the class average over cv[0] computed in closed form per G-conditioned q so only the q distribution is sampled; 3.21e7 X-samples give 0.1206019 +- 0.0000031, and the equal-weight mean over the 256 byte-classes returns 0.066894531 against 0.06689453125); the earlier 2^20-q interval [0.11987, 0.12135] is superseded and not used. (b) Given the message-difference profile of a good pair (both members' W16..W37), the state part of acceptance is the same for good pairs with cv[0] uniform in the class as for those with cv[0] uniform (the law of H2-P1 and H8). The message part is measured and charged: the class's good pairs are accepted with probability at least 2^-0.0225 x 2^MSG_LO q3r = 2^-0.0344 q3r, (no Lemma T or a-bar upper form needed under Section 7 full-cycle ustart). The rates used (F7R and MSG_CLS) were measured on a second pool independent of the class selection.

The class-12 F7 rate has one-sided 99% lower bound 0.1205926 and upper bound 0.1206112 under the unchanged H9 law.
heuristics.scope: F7R and F7R_HI only; hence q_pf, stopped-path expected work, N_CV and the final time ledger.
heuristics.limitations: Inherited public-parent participant measurement; the estimator is not organizer-executed here and H9's deep conditional-state transfer remains a premise.
heuristics.extrapolation: Directly inherited from GoForceX submission 6c6ee7a2; its exhaustive-density estimator enumerates per-top-byte F7 density and samples only the G-conditioned q distribution.

restrictions: Target sha256-r38-prefix-v1 exactly: SHA-256 steps 0..37 on every padded block, the standard IV once, FIPS 180-4 padding, feed-forward, all eight digest words. Output: two distinct 128-byte messages M0||M1 and M0||M1' (common first block) with equal digests; step 3b accepts only if A34..A37, E34..E37 match (Lemma 1, Section 1).

Restrict to seven relative columns 0..6 (NCOL=7): coverage (P(u) - 8174) mod 8192 < 56 (29,360,128 words), probe limit 61 (122 probing low values), 7*2^19 = 3,670,016 compact 30-byte records (110,100,480 B) + 32-byte pad + 5,242,880 B allowance = 115,343,392 B online image. Six 39-bit lanes/record; first-six cyclic retention; exact retained count E(8174, 7) = 20,811,431.

Deterministic full-cycle ustart (fixes F-PROB-EPOCH-MIXTURE): iterate deterministically over all N_E = 2^32 = 4,294,967,296 epochs ustart in 0..2^32-1, each executing K = 528,101,566,268 first blocks (N_CV = N_E*K = 2,268,178,956,087,436,771,328). By linearity of expectation over all 2^32 tables and prod_u (1 - p(u))^K <= exp(-K sum_u p(u)), total failure probability uses the exact cycle-averaged Bonferroni lower bound (1 - 2^-8.5)*E[X] under H3-P1 with zero Jensen/mixture gap.
